name: Network Operations Centre
desc: Core routers, firewalls and the campus fibre backbone. Every block links back here.

name: Main Gate
desc: Main entrance on IIT Road, Jatni: cream arch with gold bands, white column clusters, central emblem pillar and black iron gates. Security cabins and gate CCTV network.

name: Main Building
desc: Main administrative building: stepped cream tiers, columned entrance and a golden dome.

name: Auditorium
desc: Main auditorium: rounded stone drum with stepped slab fins, glass foyer under a floating canopy, curved entrance steps and a paved forecourt with fountain planter.

name: Central Library
desc: Central library: octagonal reading tower with a glass roof and two wings (placeholder until photos arrive).

name: Academic Complex
desc: Circular academic complex with lecture halls and domed halls.

name: School of Earth, Ocean and Climate Sciences
desc: Earth, ocean and climate research school.

name: School of Infrastructure
desc: Civil and infrastructure engineering school.

name: School of Mechanical Sciences
desc: Mechanical engineering workshops and labs.
